comment: Registry of projects patuh checks. Baselines pin the state Irvan approved; drift is reported, never auto-fixed. Licenses differ per project on purpose - patuh records them and warns on change (relicensing needs his confirmation per repo).

projects.package_note: App family renamed to intodo 2026-11-18 with his approval; applicationId com.vanipy.intodo unchanged, so installed apps update in place.

extra_modules.note: separate diagnostic app with its own signing key; not gallery-listed

projects.package_note: Renamed 2026-11-18 with his yes; the old com.vanipy.fae install stays on the phone as a separate app with its own settings.
projects.icon_note: Generated by tools/badge_icon.py: in-app rocket launching out of a parcel, version strip, single-density res/drawable/ic_launcher.png, manifest android:icon=@drawable/ic_launcher.
Has mipmap-anydpi-v26 adaptive wrapper (@color background + @mipmap/ic_launcher_foreground) reviewed 2026-11-17; patuh checks the referenced resources exist and pixel-checks the raster set.

projects.note: spikes/ and prototypes/ modules are experiments with their own IDs (com.vanipy.saku.synthetic, com.vanipy.saku.storageprobe) and are not checked
Android app is consolidated under android/ alongside the unchanged website. Its AGPL license applies to the Android subtree; package and signing identity unchanged.
Website (vanipy.com/kapan/ with /jakarta/ and /jogja/ routes); no APK. Checked for README, license baseline, commit author and naming only.
